subject: Expansion amendment & key provisioning for Arcadia Retail
messages:
From: Melissa Grant <melissa@arcadiaretail.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Expansion request — extra teams + renewal question

Hi Markus,

Quick note from my side — Arcadia is planning to bring an additional 9 internal teams (roughly 14 new apps/features) onto Redwood next quarter. We currently have the standard hosted plan with the 300k token monthly commit and a handful of API keys; with the expansion we expect token usage to increase ~2.8x.

A few asks:
- Can you provide an amendment that adds the app/key bundles and outlines updated pricing for the higher commit tiers?
- What lead time do you need to provision scoped API keys (we prefer keys per app to enforce separate quotas)?
- We’re approaching our annual renewal in 3 weeks — would the amendment roll into the renewal, or should we do a mid-term amendment?

CCing Tom (engineering lead) for scheduling any technical kickoff.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we have a partner meeting next Wednesday and want a high-level schedule.

Thanks,
Melissa
Melissa Grant
Head of Platform Integrations
Arcadia Retail
melissa@arcadiaretail.com
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Melissa Grant <melissa@arcadiaretail.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — extra teams + renewal question

Hi Melissa — thanks for the note and the heads-up. High level: we can support the expanded footprint and have two pragmatic paths depending on how you want to handle budget vs. flexibility. I’ve attached a draft amendment with two pricing options (committed tier vs. staged overage model). See attached: Arcadia_Amendment_v2.pdf.

Quick answers:
- API keys: we can provision scoped keys per app. Typical lead time for bulk keys is 2 business days once the amendment is countersigned and we have the key naming/owner list.
- Renewal handling: we can do a mid-term amendment that amends commit and adds a set number of API keys; the amendment can either extend to the next renewal (rolled into annual pricing) or be a standalone addendum that transitions on renewal. I’ve outlined both options on page 2 of the PDF.
- Rollout: recommend a 3-phase rollout — 1) pilot (3 apps), 2) staggered activation (next 6 apps), 3) full activation (remaining apps). We’ll provide a checklist and runbook.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal review of the amendment and confirm preferred pricing option (committed vs staged).
2) Laura to schedule CSM kick-off and collect app-owner list.
3) Ben to validate capacity plan and confirm whether Dedicated pool bump is needed.

If this looks good I’ll route the DocuSign link for signature and we’ll provision keys right after countersign.

Best,
Markus Klein
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
Attachment: Arcadia_Amendment_v2.pdf

Ben: please review the attached amendment and the usage estimate Melissa provided. Thanks — Markus

Subject: Re: Internal: Arcadia expansion — pricing & rollout tasks

Quick technical readout:
- Capacity: hosted pool likely handles incremental load if traffic is spiky but short-lived. For steady-state + predictable latency, recommend bumping their Dedicated capacity by one slot (equivalent to +40% baseline throughput) or enable burst capacity with a 72-hr warm window.
- Keys: we support namespacing keys by project/app. Lead time: 1 business day to generate keys; 2 business days if you want unique RBAC owners and email-based key claims.
- Token quotas: default per-key token limits can be set; suggested approach: pilot keys with 50k token cap, then raise per app after observation.
- Rollout checklist: I’ll populate rollout_checklist.xlsx with steps (DNS/webhook verification, rate-limit guards, KV cache warm-up guidance, observability hooks).

I’m attaching an initial checklist stub. I’ll sync with Tom once Laura sets the kickoff.

Ben Carter
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
Attachment: rollout_checklist.xlsx
